Metadata.title: Parkfairy
Metadata.description: Find and book parking ahead of time.

Home.title: Parking, booked before you arrive.
Home.lead: Reserve a spot at garages and private spaces near where you are going, with the full price shown up front.
Home.featuredLead: Garages and private spaces you can compare right now.

search.title: Search
search.text: Pick an area or use your location, then choose when you arrive and when you leave.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See opening hours, free spaces and the full price for your stay before you go.

park.title: Park
park.text: Head to your named space. Online booking is coming soon.

Home.accountText: Create a free account to be ready when online booking opens.
Home.ownerHeading: Have a parking space you don’t always use?
Home.ownerText: List it on Parkfairy and earn from it. It takes a few steps, and you can stop and carry on whenever you like.

landing.title: Earn from the parking you already have
landing.lead: List a garage, a yard or a single space. Drivers find it, and you stay in charge of prices and opening hours.

need.details: Your name or your company’s, an address and a phone number
need.tax: Your tax number and, for companies, the registration number
need.proof: A document showing you may rent out this parking: a deed, a lease or a licence

steps.about: Tell us about yourself (you only do this once)
steps.place: Describe your parking: where it is, its spaces and its hours
steps.prices: Set your prices and cancellation policy
steps.review: Add photos and proof, then send it to us to check

landing.saveNote: Everything saves as you go, so you can stop and carry on whenever suits you.

dashboard.lead: Everything you’ve entered is saved. Carry on from where you stopped.

stepLeads.profile: Who drivers’ payments go to. Drivers don’t see this.
stepLeads.tax: EU tax rules (DAC7) make us collect these from anyone who rents out parking through a platform. We keep them encrypted and only you can change them.
stepLeads.location: Where your parking is, and how to describe it to drivers.
stepLeads.spaces: Every space has its own name, so a driver knows exactly where to park.
stepLeads.hours: When drivers can come and go. A stay must fall within these hours.
stepLeads.prices: What a stay costs, and what happens if a driver cancels.
stepLeads.photos: Good photos help drivers recognise the entrance and trust the listing.
stepLeads.proof: We need to see that you may rent out this parking. Drivers never see this document.
stepLeads.review: Check everything once more, then send it to us.
